name: Neton

attributes.attribute: mate of the war goddess Nemain
may be the same figure as Nemed
some tales place Net among them

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Neton is the name of an Irish god, written Net. He is an obscure divinity whose sole link is to the war goddess Nemain as her partner. For that reason he is presumed a god of war. Net could stand among the few Celtic gods of war, since goddesses more often governed Celtic lands. He could likewise prove identical to Nemed, the spouse of Macha. Nemain is sometimes confused with Macha. Tales about Net conflict. Certain stories count him among the monstrous Fomorians, whereas others set his beginnings elsewhere.
